newsitem.title: UK: Lloyds TSB says Q1 ahead of last year.
newsitem.headline: Lloyds TSB says Q1 ahead of last year.

text.p: Britain's TSB Group Plc said on Tuesday that its first quarter of 1997 had started well with profits during the period ahead of the corresponding quarter in the previous year.

"I am pleased to report that 1997 has also started well, with profits for the first quarter of this year well up on the first quarter of last year," Brian Pitman, the group's chairman, told shareholders at its annual general meeting.
Pitman said the group was riding on the UK's favourable economy which had triggered a demand for its products, leading to an increase in market share.
"Volumes have increased, the net interest margin has widened slightly and costs remain under tight control," Pitman said.
